description.value: A sunny Kootenay park centred on Surveyors Lake's warm water and sandy beaches, with paved internal roads, water-craft rentals, and summer interpretive programs; the gate closes outside the operating season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a legitimate BC Parks campground within Kikomun Creek Park, operated by EK Parks Ltd. The park page explicitly mentions cycling ('paved roads within this family oriented park are conducive to biking') and lists Surveyors Lake for swimming, canoeing, and kayaking. OSM provides capacity (104 sites), phone, email, and tags for fee=yes, internet_access=no, power_supply=no, and sanitary_dump_station=yes. Reservations are confirmed via the BC Parks reservation system (camping.bcparks.ca). Most amenity details are not mentioned on the website, so they remain null per the rules.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-422-3003) and email (info@ekparks.com) belong to the park operator EK Parks Ltd., not BC Parks directly; could not confirm these on the BC Parks website
No street address available in OSM or on the website; directions are given relative to Highway 3 near Elko/Jaffray
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate BC Parks campground with 104 sites, explicitly cycling-friendly with paved roads, lakeside setting appealing to touring cyclists in the East Kootenay region.

wow_evidence: Surveyors Lake for swimming, canoeing, and kayaking ... paved roads within this family oriented park are conducive to biking
